author: Kirill / andrico21

methods.latency: Serial fresh contexts, alternating variants by sample plus mode parity; no discarded samples. Actual UI select and native range keyboard End; two RAF then state readback included in wall milliseconds. No CDP sessions in latency contexts.
methods.legacy: lab-refresh-rotation; initial seek 0, measured seek 1000. Legacy select is untimed preparation.
methods.dns: Candidate-only five representatives; deterministic rotation by sample, separate selection and end seek measurements; actual default named case recorded.
methods.memory: Separate phase only after all latency work. Fresh context for each mode/variant/family; warm each fixture once, then checkpoint zero. Each cycle selects each family fixture, seeks End then Home. CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage twice before Runtime.getHeapUsage and Memory.getDOMCounters at 0/3/6/12 cycles. Not a memory-leak test.
methods.limits: Chromium only; empty context cache/storage, not cold OS/JIT. Wall timings include automation and observation overhead. GC stabilization means two forced collections, not guaranteed quiescence or leak attribution. Fixed bounded cycles cannot establish long-run behavior. No thresholds or acceptance decisions. Worksheet is identity-bound context, not an imported outcome oracle.
methods.initialCursor: Home on an already-zero, unstarted player may leave row null at cursor eventIndex -1 and elapsed0. This valid untouched initial state is not a missing replay row. A reached Home endpoint with a row must be source event0/before; End must have an actual row/nonnegative cursor. No additional warmup or control action is inserted.
